snippet.title: Guilty Gear X Plus Opening and All Characters [PS2]
snippet.description:
Guilty Gear X Plus (ギルティギア ゼクスプラス) - Opening/Intro & All Characters / Character Select Showcase for PS2.
In this video, we feature the opening cinematic along with a complete character select showcase of all fighters, hidden characters, and playable roster in Guilty Gear X Plus on PlayStation 2.
Watch the iconic opening intro and the full fighter select lineup in crisp high quality!
